The receiving team will verify that the signed office note plus its signature page are present and update the package completeness status; only their acknowledgment confirms receipt. If the office says it already sent the note but no receipt is found, compare the office’s transmission report, the submitted-package inventory, and the receiving-team checks to resolve any discrepancy.
suggestedFollowups: Ask the office for transmission time, channel, and reference so receiving can search for it.
If no acknowledgment arrives, request the receiving team check routing and document association and report back.
